principles: Do not change candidate generation or delete audit evidence.
Do not use benchmark TP/FP to classify a route.
Independent exact pathogen-specific evidence may retain high-confidence candidate status.
Analytical-only, imaging-only, group-to-member, history-supported, technical-repeat, and best-available routes cannot be called production-validated Picked.
Fallback is visible to physicians only in a separate low-confidence supplement and is excluded from the primary pulmonary-pathogen endpoint.
